# NEW 2026-11-24 v25.0 Colonization 4.0 (oe_col4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v250_colonization4.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Transfers overseas holdings in scope:oe_col4_region to scope:target_colony.
# AI transfers non-core conquests; human players may also consolidate overseas colonial frontier holdings.
oe_col4_transfer_region_to_colony = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:oe_col4_region
			exists = scope:target_colony
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				region ?= scope:oe_col4_region
				NOT = { continent = root.capital.continent }
				OR = {
					NOT = { is_core_of = root }
					AND = {
						root = { is_ai = no }
						oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = yes
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:target_colony
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Transfers only INLAND overseas holdings in scope:oe_col4_region (keeps coastal ports as Crown enclaves).
oe_col4_transfer_inland_to_colony = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:oe_col4_region
			exists = scope:target_colony
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				region ?= scope:oe_col4_region
				is_coastal = no
				NOT = { continent = root.capital.continent }
				OR = {
					NOT = { is_core_of = root }
					AND = {
						root = { is_ai = no }
						oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = yes
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:target_colony
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Converts scope:conq_subject (peacetime conquistador army country) into a proper Colonial Nation.
oe_col4_charter_conquistador_viceroyalty = {
	scope:conq_subject = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_reform = government_reform:conquistador_country }
			remove_reform = government_reform:conquistador_country
		}
		change_country_type = location
		make_subject_of = {
			target = root
			type = subject_type:colonial_nation
		}
		add_gold = 100
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_viceroy_charter_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Checks if a peacetime conquistador subject is ready for formal chartering (used by on_ending_war & yearly pulse).
oe_col4_check_peacetime_conquistador = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				has_reform = government_reform:conquistador_country
				is_subject_type = conquistador
			}
			at_war = no
			num_locations >= 1
			exists = overlord
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_conq_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_conq_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
		save_scope_as = conq_subject
		overlord = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.20 days = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Evaluates a newly conquered overseas location for regional colonial handover (batched per region via 15-day debounce).
oe_col4_eval_conquest_handover = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:location
			NOT = { capital.continent = scope:location.continent }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_transfer_cd }
		}
		scope:location.region = { save_scope_as = oe_col4_region }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_col4_has_regional_colony = yes }
			set_variable = { name = oe_col4_transfer_cd value = 1 days = 15 }
			ordered_subject = {
				limit = {
					oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
					exists = capital
					capital = { region = scope:oe_col4_region }
				}
				order_by = total_population
				max = 1
				save_scope_as = target_colony
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target_colony }
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = yes }
					oe_col4_transfer_region_to_colony = yes
					scope:target_colony = { oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes }
				}
				else = {
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.1 days = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Applies Colonization 4.0 unified multi-civilization colonial name & adjective (A5, 0 vanilla overrides).
# Runs once per overseas colonial subject on charter completion, handover, conquistador chartering, or yearly check.
oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
			exists = overlord
			exists = capital
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_named }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_named value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { overlord = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group } } }
			if = {
				limit = { capital = { region = region:east_coast_region } }
				change_country_name = oe_scn_col4_greek_east_coast
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_col4_greek_east_coast_ADJ
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { capital = { region = region:canada_region } }
				change_country_name = oe_scn_col4_greek_canada
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_col4_greek_canada_ADJ
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { capital = { region = region:caribbean_region } }
				change_country_name = oe_scn_col4_greek_caribbean
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_col4_greek_caribbean_ADJ
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { capital = { region = region:mesoamerica_region } }
				change_country_name = oe_scn_col4_greek_mesoamerica
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_col4_greek_mesoamerica_ADJ
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { capital = { region = region:central_america_region } }
